subject: MAP Technical Close: Org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP Technical Close: Org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our MAP we want to lock the remaining technical prerequisites so the POC can be production-like next week. Attached is a compact checklist (redwood_map_tech_checklist.xlsx) but main asks below. Can you confirm owners and ETA for items 1–4?

1) Org & billing: please confirm the Redown account alias you want us to use (recommended: cardiosense-redwood) and the primary admin SSO user. We'll provision the org and invite your admin.

2) API keys / service accounts: we recommend a scoped service account (name: cs-poc-redwood-sa) that your Security team will mint. If you prefer Redwood to generate keys, we can create them and rotate on signoff.

3) IP allowlist: provide the outbound CIDR ranges (and team owning the firewall change). We will need allowlist entries for the POC control plane and inference egress (I list our recommended ranges in the attached checklist).

4) VPC peering: please confirm AWS account ID for peering and a desired maintenance window (we can do a daytime or 02:00–04:00 UTC window). Route table and VPN details also helpful.

Target timeline we propose:
- Today: confirm owners and provide network diagram (ops@cardiosense.com)
- Mon 9/20: org provisioned + API key handed off
- Tue 9/21: IP allowlist and peering test window
- Wed 9/22: POC acceptance run (smoke tests)

If any of these dates don't work we can shift but need sign-offs by Mon 9/20 to hit Wed 9/22.

Thanks — attaching checklist and an .ics draft for the MAP close calendar.

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_map_tech_checklist.xlsx, map_action_calendar.ics

- Owners: Security lead Samir Patel (samir.patel@cardiosense.com) is primary for keys and allowlist; Network Ops (ops@cardiosense.com) owns peering.
- AWS account for peering: 987654321098 (we'll confirm via Secure Notes)

I attached the high-level network diagram (cardiosense_network_layout.pdf). A couple of questions:

If everything above is ok we'll aim to have owners confirm by end of day.

Subject: Re: MAP Technical Close: Org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Alex / Ops —

Thanks for the quick response and the network diagram — that helps. A few concrete items and samples to unblock your SRE team:

Org / admin steps (10–30m):
- Confirm desired org alias (e.g., cardiosense-redwood). We will invite the SSO admin and your admin confirms SAML config.
- Provide primary admin email for invite.

API key / service account (10–20m manual + optional script):
- Preferred SA name: cs-poc-redwood-sa. If you want us to generate the key, we will post a short-lived secret to the shared secure vault; otherwise your Security can call our API:

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/orgs/cardiosense-redwood/api-keys \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ADMIN_TOKEN>" \
    -d '{"name":"cs-poc-redwood-sa","scopes":["inference:invoke","logs:write"]}'

- Keys are returned as a JSON object with key id and secret; recommend storing in your vault and rotating after POC.

IP allowlist (requires Network Ops change, 15m):
- We can reduce to the following minimal endpoint set for the control plane (single IPs):
  - control.redwood-us1.prod 34.201.15.42
  - metrics.redwood-us1.prod 34.201.15.87
  - inference-egress-us1 54.210.33.19

(If you'd rather use CIDRs for egress we can provide 54.210.33.0/24 — note egress can change with scale; we'll coordinate via the peering ticket.)

VPC peering requirements:
- We'll need: your AWS account ID, VPC ID for the spoke VPC, and a route table to accept the peering routes.
- Peering validation steps (we will open a support ticket PR-778 and coordinate the route exchange).

Shared artifacts and next steps:
- Drive folder with onboarding docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CardioMAP
- Action: please have Samir confirm by EOD Mon 9/20 for us to hit the 9/22 smoke test.

If you prefer Redwood to create an ephemeral API key and hand it to your Security team for vault-ing we can do that during the org provisioning step on Mon.

—
Neha Kapoor
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
